issues.jp_before: (18 lines, all gv-kureru / gv-ageru / gv-morau-distractor lines: 1-5, 7-24)
issues.problem: Distractor misspelled as もらました / もらます (not a well-formed word; learners could reject it on spelling alone).
issues.action: Corrected to もらいました / もらいます throughout.

issues.jp_before: 同僚[どうりょう]が私[わたし]に出張[しゅっちょう]のお土産[みやげ]を{くれました|gv-kureru}。
issues.problem: Distractor くださいました is acceptable for a colleague (often senior) in polite speech; only a register difference, not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced distractor with さしあげました.

issues.jp_before: 先輩[せんぱい]がこの前[まえ]、私[わたし]に試験[しけん]の過去問[かこもん]を{くれました|gv-kureru}。
issues.problem: Distractor くださいました is natural for a 先輩 in polite speech; why called a senior student a 'peer'.
issues.action: Replaced distractor with さしあげました; why rewritten ('An older student gives to me').

issues.jp_before: 同[おな]じクラスの田中[たなか]さんは、いつも私[わたし]にお菓子[かし]を{くれます|gv-kureru}。
issues.problem: Distractor くださいます is only an over-polite register shift, not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced distractor with さしあげます.

issues.jp_before: だれが君[きみ]にこのペンを{くれた|gv-kureru}の？
issues.problem: Distractor くださった is a register shift (どなたがくださったの is possible), not a direction error; English carried an awkward parenthetical note.
issues.action: Replaced distractor with さしあげた; English simplified to "Who gave you this pen?".

issues.jp_before: 妹[いもうと]は試験[しけん]に受[う]かった友達[ともだち]にお守[まも]りを{あげました|gv-ageru}。
issues.problem: Implausible scenario: a good-luck charm is given before an exam, not after passing it.
issues.action: Rewrote to 試験[しけん]を受[う]ける友達 / 'a friend who was about to take an exam'.

issues.jp_before: 私[わたし]は同僚[どうりょう]に出張[しゅっちょう]のお土産[みやげ]を{もらいました|gv-morau}。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the 同僚 / 出張のお土産 くれる item (and the 社長 さしあげる item).
issues.action: Rewrote object to 使[つか]いやすい手帳[てちょう] ('an easy-to-use planner').
